featured_reviews.name: Mayukh Datta
featured_reviews.review_text:
BEWARE
They may have a decent collection but they surely habe extremely horrendous staff.
I  bought three sets of cloth on Sat 26 Apr for delivery Tue 29 Apr max. Got no messages or smson delivery timelines. They don't have any such sms intimation mechanism.
Started following on Wed 30 Apr with Murli sales executive. Revert was will get by Fri 2 May.
On Fri 2 May the revert was will get two set out of three on Sat 3 May. Actually there was one set received by them on Sat evening at their end and they don't know when will the the other two sets come.
On Sunday 4 May, I asked Shelton the Manager he said will have to check. It shows that they don't have a daily check of pending orders and delivery.  They do not match or discuss every day what they have booked as sale and what is pending for delivery vs what they promised and what is the pendency.
When I asked for Manager Mr. Dubey number they refused. As of now I have no idea of what their delivery timelines are whether I will get it or not at all.

featured_reviews.name: madhuri mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: We have always enjoyed shopping furnishings at Ddecor store - Bandra ! Amazing variety and our sofa , carpets , cushions and curtains done by their fabric and carpenters made our home look unique and differentiated !!

featured_reviews.name: Vishnu Vishnu
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered curtains from a new series which did not have full images or full length pieces. The pattern of one of the main curtains is very different after stitching and not as we imagined after seeing the swatches. Don’t order curtains without seeing the full length look. D Decor doesn’t  really care after product delivery! It is customer’s mistake even if we were not guided properly in selections where full images are not available. Very disappointing experience! They are also tied up with unprofessional tailors who keep you waiting and don’t care for your time! Tailor behaves like he is doing you a great favor by coming on the same day of appointment even if not the same time! AVOID!
